Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

At this year's career day, two students' parents had early morning slots. One, a professor, the other a farm worker. The farm worker unfortunately had to cancel at the last minute, which surprised no one given they never come to any school events, even parent-teacher meetings. The presentation by the professor was a delight, though! Who involves themself in their kids education?
A. The farm worker
B. The professor
C. Not known
